learning_outcomes.text: Organize and plan within the business environment.
Solve problems with initiative, decision-making, creativity, critical reasoning, and communicate and transmit knowledge, skills, and abilities in the field of Business Engineering.
Acquire basic knowledge of manufacturing and production systems.
Acquire applied knowledge of production organization.
Acquire knowledge in basic and technological subjects that enable the learning of new methods and theories and provide versatility to adapt to new situations.
Acquire knowledge about mandatory specifications, regulations, and standards.
Acquire knowledge about the influence of business decisions on environmental impact.

syllabus_topics: MODULE I: INTRODUCTION TO BUSINESS ECONOMY
The company as a system: Business Subsystems
The commercial system of the company
MODULE II: THE FINANCING AND INVESTMENT SYSTEM IN THE COMPANY
The economic-financial structure of the company
The economic-financial balance of the company
The analysis of profit and profitability: The value of the company
Analysis of the company's financial statements
Investment in the company. Concept and types of investment
The influence of time on the value of money. Investment selection criteria
MODULE III. THE COMPANY'S PRODUCTION SYSTEM
The production system in the company: Objectives, Decisions, Logistics
Cost Analysis: break-even point, leverage, margins
teaching_methods: Cooperative learning activities / Group project work
assessment_rules: The final exam has a weight of 75% and requires a minimum score of 5 out of 10, with a resit option. Individual and group assignments and reports are worth 15% and 10% respectively and are not recoverable. Individual continuous assessment will only be considered in the final grade if all 4 practical assignments are submitted by the indicated deadline.
